t: The Flomasta Straight Coupler 15mm is a fast-fit plastic plumbing connector that delivers leak-free performance with no tools or hot works. Its push-fit, dual locking design works with copper or plastic pipe, providing a simple, secure solution. WRAS approved and demountable, it’s a reliable plumbing fitting built to save time on every job.
b: Suitable for Hard & Soft Water Areas
